name: Rootly Agent Skills
tagline: Seven skills for incident response, on-call, and deploy readiness
description: Investigate incidents, triage alerts, assess deploy readiness and service health, look up on-call coverage, and draft incident updates and retrospectives. The skills use evidence from the Rootly MCP server.

install.notes: Connect the Rootly MCP server and sign in to use these skills with live Rootly data. For read-only access, use the hosted URL https://mcp.rootly.com/mcp?toolsets=all&readonly=true.
